verdict_reason: The polling/compile loop is well-reasoned and dev-only, but the DevTools trigger-file it depends on is never configured (so restarts fire mid-compile and twice per edit) and the hard-coded run profile silently overrides SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.

todos.issue: The .reloadtrigger file only gates DevTools when spring.devtools.restart.trigger-file is set, and that property is set nowhere (application-local.yml, application.yml, pom.xml, backend.compose.yml/dev.compose.yml all lack it), so DevTools restarts on any change under target/classes and the 'only reload on a successful compile' guard at lines 35-37 has no effect
todos.fix: Add spring.devtools.restart.trigger-file: .reloadtrigger to src/main/resources/application-local.yml (or pass -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments=-Dspring.devtools.restart.trigger-file=.reloadtrigger on line 45) so DevTools restarts only when the script touches the trigger

todos.issue: The DevTools trigger-file mechanism the header comment describes is inert: 'spring.devtools.restart.trigger-file' is not set anywhere in the repo (grep finds devtools only in pom.xml), so DevTools restarts on the first .class the background 'mvn compile' writes rather than on 'touch target/classes/.reloadtrigger' — meaning a restart can fire mid-compile against a half-written target/classes, and the trigger touch then causes a second, redundant restart per edit.
todos.fix: Add 'spring.devtools.restart.trigger-file: .reloadtrigger' under 'spring.devtools.restart' in src/main/resources/application-local.yml (or pass it via -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments) so DevTools only restarts when the trigger file is touched after a successful compile.

todos.issue: '-Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local' is hard-coded; the spring-boot-maven-plugin turns it into a '--spring.profiles.active=local' command-line argument, which is the highest-precedence property source and therefore silently overrides the SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE env var that compose.yml (line 59) and the workspace run-stack set — so an operator adding a profile (e.g. SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local,debug) gets it ignored with no warning.
todos.fix: Honour the environment: 'exec mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles="${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:-local}"', or drop the flag entirely and rely on SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE which compose.yml already sets.

todos.issue: The hot-reload compile runs offline ('mvn -o') while the foreground 'mvn spring-boot:run' (line 45) runs online — an inconsistency with a concrete failure mode: 'dependency:go-offline' (Dockerfile line 75) is well known to miss plugin artefacts, so if anything needed by the process-classes lifecycle was not pre-fetched, every recompile fails offline, the guarded 'if' swallows it, the trigger is never touched, and hot reload is permanently and silently dead while the container stays healthy.
todos.fix: Drop '-o' so the watcher can fetch anything go-offline missed (the container already has network for spring-boot:run), and surface a failure explicitly, e.g. 'mvn -q compile || echo "dev-run: recompile failed" >&2'.
